notes.title: Let's Play Lazerball!
notes.content:
With lasers, explosions and electrified balls bouncing around the screen, watch as a we battle it out in the Lazerball arena! 

This multiplayer game is made for competitive, hectic fun! gather round and play a few rounds with your mates, all trying to out-manoeuvre their friends and win the day!

Aim the ball, blast it, curve it and get that perfect impact! 
With high intensity tracks and a whimsical commentator, we see if the Developer of the game can be beaten!
